newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Profit-taking knocks Estonian shares lower.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking knocks Estonian shares lower.

text.p: The Estonian stock market was active again on Thursday although prices slipped after hectic gains earlier this week, dealers said.
The main official list turned over some 42.2 million kroons but the stock exchange index slipped 1.31 percent to 144.09.
"It seems that investors have taken profits from the last days gains but provided at the same time buying opportunities which helped fuel other business," said one dealer.
Second largest bank, Estonian Savings Bank, turned over 12.6 million kroons and closed higher at 63 kroons versus 61.95.
Shares in Forekspank, which had climbed on previous days, saw trades worth 9.4 million kroons but it ended lower at 99 kroons against 102.30.
Market leader Hansapank had volume of 6.9 million kroons and ended down at 142 kroons versus 143.25.
Union bank registered turnover of 6.5 million kroons and ended higher at 30.20 kroons compared with 29.50.
Meat processer Rakvere was the most traded stock on the free market with volume of 4.8 million kroons but it closed unchanged at nine kroons.
The total volume of over-the-counter market trade reached was 7.3 million kroons.
